Romance and even marry a sexy, dirty talking Caroline who is very interested in getting to know you.  Includes updated portraits, sprites, events, dialogue, mail, and [s]schedule[/s].  Most can be configured to be enabled/disabled to suit your preferences. (**Although not using the sprite sheets will definitely cause issues during wedding and when kissing her**).  In fact, you can configure this mod to be completely SFW material :3 (vanilla shirt portrait and sprite, dialogue disabled).

[size=3]***This mod requires you to use a new save rather than an existing one, since it edits NPC data that can only be set once per game file.***[/size]
